stories.title: Judge orders Meta to pay $25bn over data-privacy 'lies'
stories.summary: A federal judge in New Mexico ordered Meta to pay $25bn after a trial found the company intentionally misled the public about how it handled Facebook user data. The judge said the deception went to the heart of Meta's core business practices.

stories.title: Russia says it is ready to resume Ukraine talks with US
stories.summary: The Kremlin said Russia is 'ready in principle' to restart trilateral talks with the US and Ukraine, with a new round possibly around 10 November in Abu Dhabi. The statement followed a three-hour meeting between Putin and US envoy Steve Witkoff in St Petersburg.

stories.title: Macron accuses foreign leaders of exploiting French riots
stories.summary: Emmanuel Macron accused unnamed foreign leaders of using France's riots for electoral gain and of amplifying AI-generated fakes about the unrest. He appeared to point at Benjamin Netanyahu and Donald Trump, both facing elections in the coming weeks.

stories.title: Nigeria confirms Ebola case linked to East Africa outbreak
stories.summary: Nigeria reported an Ebola case in a woman who travelled from Uganda to Abuja, the first West African case tied to the East African outbreak. Authorities have isolated the patient and identified 44 close contacts for tracing.

stories.title: Walmart opens its shelves to AI shopping agents
stories.summary: Walmart launched an Agent Gateway MCP server that lets approved AI agents search its inventory and buy on a shopper's behalf across Walmart and Sam's Club. The move contrasts with Amazon, which has been blocking outside agents from its store.

stories.title: AI-found PHP flaws force government sites offline
stories.summary: Government websites in Europe and elsewhere went dark on Wednesday after researchers, using AI tools, disclosed critical vulnerabilities in PHP, the language underpinning much of the web. Emergency patches were rushed out as the FBI and NSA warned operators to update immediately.

stories.title: EA is shutting down BioWare
stories.summary: EA confirmed it is closing BioWare, the studio behind Mass Effect, Dragon Age and Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic. The publisher also ended development on the next Mass Effect game that had been in the works.

stories.title: SpaceX to try a Starship catch, eyeing weekly launches
stories.summary: SpaceX will attempt another tower catch of Starship on its next flight as it pushes toward weekly Starship launches by early 2027. The company is betting a faster cadence on the vehicle it sees as central to its satellite and AI-infrastructure ambitions.

stories.title: Jeudy says Titans game, not trade talk, is his focus
stories.summary: Browns receiver Jerry Jeudy is again the subject of trade speculation but said his only concern is Sunday's game at Tennessee. Cleveland enters Week 7 at 3-1 and tied atop the AFC North.

stories.title: Browns head to Tennessee with pass game in focus
stories.summary: The Browns' official preview for Sunday's game at Tennessee centers on whether Deshaun Watson can move the ball through the air against a Titans defense allowing 220.6 yards per game. Cleveland is averaging 173.5 passing yards per game, 25th in the league.

stories.title: Browns add DT Eric Johnson II to practice squad
stories.summary: Cleveland signed defensive tackle Eric Johnson II to the practice squad and released defensive end Nadame Tucker from it. The move adds interior depth ahead of Sunday's trip to Tennessee.

stories.title: Ohio State RB Ja'Kobi Jackson has foot surgery
stories.summary: Ohio State running back Ja'Kobi Jackson underwent foot surgery, a source confirmed to ESPN, adding to the Buckeyes' injury list during their bye week. No return timeline was given.

stories.title: Buckeyes climb to No. 1 in Big Ten power rankings
stories.summary: CBS Sports moved Ohio State to the top of its Week 8 Big Ten rankings after the 19-15 win at Indiana, but flagged the quarterback uncertainty created by Julian Sayin's injury. The Buckeyes have a bye before facing USC on Halloween.

stories.title: Fahey or St. Clair? Ohio State weighs its options at QB
stories.summary: With Julian Sayin injured, Ohio State is evaluating freshman Luke Fahey and Tavien St. Clair, and Ryan Day plans to give both first-team reps during the bye. Fahey finished the Indiana win after Sayin went down.

stories.title: Ryan Day planning to be without Sayin through postseason
stories.summary: Ryan Day said Ohio State is preparing to play without quarterback Julian Sayin through the postseason after he injured his throwing arm against Indiana. The Buckeyes host USC on Oct. 31 after their bye.

stories.title: Norris vows 'better decisions' after Piastri clash talks
stories.summary: Lando Norris said he will make better decisions going forward after further talks with McLaren about his Singapore collision with teammate Oscar Piastri. The title fight resumes at the United States Grand Prix this weekend with six rounds left.

stories.title: Mercedes unveils dramatic new look for US Grand Prix
stories.summary: Mercedes revealed a dramatically different livery for the United States Grand Prix at Circuit of the Americas. Kimi Antonelli arrives in Austin with a 102-point lead and a first shot at the drivers' title.

stories.title: Five things to watch as F1 lands in Austin
stories.summary: Motorsport.com's USGP preview says Kimi Antonelli can clinch the title in Texas, while Mercedes' constructors' crown will likely wait until Mexico, where it needs a 215-point gap against a current 134. Austin opens a triple-header with Mexico City and Sao Paulo.

stories.title: FIA moves to close F1 cost-cap loophole
stories.summary: The FIA's World Motor Sport Council approved rules requiring teams to clearly separate F1 and non-F1 staff from next season. The change targets teams that used personnel nominally assigned to other projects to work around the budget cap.

stories.title: Players find fix for Tarkov 'Error in Post' failures
stories.summary: Escape from Tarkov players hit by 'Error in Post (Error 0)' when posting offers shared a workaround: back up and reset the BSG Launcher settings file, then relaunch the game through Steam. The thread points to a Steam authentication issue rather than a server-wide outage.

stories.title: Columbus doctor, clinic manager plead guilty in $1.6M fraud
stories.summary: A Columbus doctor and a clinic manager pleaded guilty in a Medicaid fraud case involving about $1.6 million, 10TV reported. Sentencing details were not immediately available.

stories.title: Dense fog closes or delays central Ohio schools
stories.summary: Several central Ohio districts closed or pushed back start times Wednesday morning as dense fog cut visibility across the region. The fog burned off later in the day.

stories.title: Crew chase U.S. Open Cup title against St. Louis City
stories.summary: The Columbus Crew meet St. Louis City in the U.S. Open Cup final, the club's first final in 16 years and fourth overall. The Crew reached it by beating Orlando City 2-1 in September behind goals from Josef Martinez and Brais Mendez.

stories.title: Pedestrian critical after east Columbus hit-and-run
stories.summary: A pedestrian was in critical condition after being struck at East Broad Street and North Ohio Avenue in east Columbus just after 6 a.m. Wednesday. Police said the driver did not stop.
